2f33a40.summary: Handles a pointer entering a card: in hand it raises and enlarges the card with description; on the board it highlights it and previews combat outcome.

2f34200.summary: Handles a pointer leaving a card: stops description display, lowers it from hand, and resets highlight state, frame colors and scale.

2f344d4.summary: Handles touch-down on a card: shows deck sizes for enemy hand or deck cards, selects in-play cards, or logs unrecognized states.

2f3474c.summary: Handles touch release on a card: uses a waystone on remnants, returns a shown hand card, or displays the large card with effects.

2f34930.summary: Handles dragging a card by touch: starts moving a hand card or begins an attack from a board card once movement passes a threshold.

2f34a38.summary: Starts dragging a card out of the hand when the drag angle and distance qualify, playing a sound and scaling the card.

2f34d58.summary: Starts dragging a card on the board: if far enough and allowed, sets up an attack or ability use.

2f34008.summary: Highlights a card the pointer is over and, when targeting, previews whether the tracked attacker would kill this minion.

2f33b64.summary: Raises and enlarges a hand card for display, shows its description and switches card text layout.

2f3526c.summary: Builds a ShowDescription debug message and logs it if dev tools are active.

2f35344.summary: Brightens the card's highlight-and-shadow material color with a short color transition.

2f31c20.summary: Returns the card's scale in hand, logging an error if the horizontal layout is missing.

2f32fe4.summary: Returns the in-hand scale multiplied by the global moving-scale factor.

2f34360.summary: Returns a shown hand card to its original position, rotation and scale, optionally reordering the hand, and restores click handling.

2f3432c.summary: Stops showing the card description and hides the large card display when appropriate.

2f35854.summary: Forces display of the large card view with its effects, ambush trait overlay and effect icons.

2f34ec0.summary: Begins moving a card out of the hand: plays a sound, scales the card and hides its description.

2f35880.summary: Moves the card toward a target point with smoothed tilt rotation, snapping when close, then applies the rotation.

2f35ac0.summary: Logs a 'not implemented' message for ShowManaCostAura when dev tools are active.

2f35fa4.summary: Flashes or pulses the board icon for the given trait on the card UI using tweens.

2f35fbc.summary: Resets the card to its hand state: clears effects and enchantments, restores base stats, removes status traits and refreshes the card.

2f2d944.summary: Rebuilds the card's current trait list and showing-traits list from the raw card data.

2f363f4.summary: Moves a card back into the hand: undissolves or dissolves it, reparents it to the hand and updates its state and text.

2f366b0.summary: Moves a card from hand into play: sets the playing state, handles spell targeting, tints highlight and scales spells.

2f364bc.summary: Dissolves or restores a minion card over the global dissolve time and toggles its 3D body.
